recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast portrait of two men in rustic-modern attire, overlaid with horizontal distressed lines and a mix of clean geometric and expressive brush-stroke typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal graphic lines intersecting the subjects' torsos
Juxtaposition of thin red sans-serif and thick white brush lettering
Cool-toned shadows against warm skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures positioned mid-ground, filling the frame from the waist up, slightly offset from center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central red geometric text acts as the primary focal point against the dark clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the highlighted faces, move down to the red text, and settle on the large white brush lettering at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and sides to emphasize the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights; the red is the only high-saturation element.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Ultra-thin, monolinear geometric strokes with wide tracking.
Secondary text: Heavy, textured brush strokes with visible dry-brush artifacts and irregular baselines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the geometric font lacks a crossbar or has a very low one.
The brush lettering features elongated terminals and splatter effects.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between clinical geometric precision and raw, expressive hand-drawn energy.
graphicDevices: Circular graphic element on the left subject's shirt

preserve: Hairline weight of the red text
Dry-brush texture of the white text
avoid: Drop shadows on the red text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke weight.
Captures the aggressive, textured brush stroke look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-key studio portrait of two men in hats and jackets against a black background. Apply high contrast and cool-toned shadows. Overlay three thin, horizontal, distressed white lines across the middle third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a red, hairline geometric sans-serif with wide tracking across the center. Below it, add the secondary title in a large, white, distressed brush-script font, slightly tilted.

verificationChecks: Is the red text thin enough to appear delicate?
Does the brush lettering have visible texture and 'dry' edges?
Is the background pure black or near-black?
Do the horizontal lines appear as subtle film-scratches?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the horizontal distressed lines
Amount of brush splatter on the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any specific logos on the hats
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is legible despite its thinness
Verify the brush texture looks organic rather than digital
Confirm the horizontal lines do not obscure the faces
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine low-key male portraiture + horizontal film-scratch overlays + (Hairline Geometric Sans + Heavy Distressed Brush Script) typographic pairing.
